_comment: Neutral example of this spec shape. Create config/local/ (gitignored, so a clone has none), copy this file there and edit it for your own rig. Relative paths (chains[].strip, donors[].cst) resolve against 'strip_root' when the spec sets one, else LOGICXKIT_STRIP_ROOT or Logic's own Channel Strip Settings; an absolute path always wins.

Kick.cst.label: Kick
Kick.cst._source: Takes its EQ and Compressor settings from the strip named above.

Snare.cst.label: Snare
Snare.cst._source: Takes its EQ and Compressor settings from the strip named above.

gain_invert._note: Gain, set to invert polarity. No filtering and no lookahead, so it costs nothing to leave in

silververb._note: SilverVerb — algorithmic, and lighter on CPU than ChromaVerb

echo._note: Logic's own delay; a slapback insert is the usual reason to want one

enveloper._note: a transient shaper. It carries lookahead, so insert it bypassed
